title: Payment configuration
description: The process environment payment reads: an acquirer credential, a broker address by inheritance, and one kill switch.

ACQUIRER_API_KEY.description: Credential for the card acquirer, rotated every 90 days. Secret: rotating it changes nothing in git.

FEATURE_INSTANT_REFUNDS.description: Kill switch for instant refunds. Defaulted off, and not required: a switch that must be set is not a kill switch.
